params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Quinn}} damaging abilities mark enemies with ''Harrier'' and {{tip|standard sight|reveal}} them for a few seconds. Periodically, {{ui|Valor}} marks a nearby enemy with ''Harrier''.
params.blurb2: '''Quinn's''' next basic attack against a ''Harrier'' target consumes the mark to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Quinn's''' ''{{ai|Blinding Assault|Quinn}}'' against the primary target, ''{{ai|Vault|Quinn}}'', and ''{{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}}'' mark enemies hit with ''Harrier'' for 4 seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}. '''{{ci|Valor}}''' will periodically mark a nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy if no ''Harrier'' targets exist for 1 second.
params.description2: '''Quinn's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} against ''Harrier'' targets are empowered to consume the mark to deal {{pp|15 + (120-15)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=physical damage}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
params.description4: While ''{{ai|Behind Enemy Lines|Quinn}}'' is active, ''Harrier'' is disabled and all ''Harrier'' marks are removed.
params.static: {{tt|{{pp|type=critical strike chance|color=critical chance|7*(0.99^((x-1)*10))|key1=%|0 to 100 by 10|formula=7*(0.99^critical strike chance %)}}|Starts after the mark expired or was consumed or overwritten by another mark.}}
params.notes:
* If a mark applied by an ability is overwritten, consumed, or timed out, ''Harrier'' goes on a 1-second cooldown if it's not already on cooldown.
* ''Harrier's'' targeting priority:
*# Last unit hit (if it was a small minion it appears to select a different target).
*# Lowest-health enemy champion.
*# Lowest-health enemy minion.
* ''Harrier'' is consumed even if it is parried, the attack is negated in any case.
* ''Harrier'' will not mark enemy {{tip|minions}} while '''Quinn''' is not {{tip|sight|visible}}, but will mark enemy {{tip|champions}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Quinn}} sends {{ci|Valor}} in the target direction who stops upon hitting an enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to all nearby enemies.
params.blurb2: The primary target is {{tip|nearsight|nearsighted}} briefly if they are a {{tip|champion}}, and {{tip|disarm|disarmed}} otherwise.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Quinn''' sends '''{{ci|Valor}}''' in the target direction who stops upon hitting an enemy, marking them with ''{{ai|Harrier|Quinn}}'' and dealing {{as|physical damage}} to all nearby enemies, increased to 200% against {{tip|monsters}}.
params.description2: The primary target is {{tip|nearsight|nearsighted}} for {{fd|1.75}} seconds if they are a {{tip|champion}}, reducing their {{tip|sight}} radius to 350 units. Otherwise, they are {{tip|disarm|disarmed}} for the same duration.
params.notes:
* ''Blinding Assault's'' {{tip|nearsight}} will persist through {{tip|death}}.
{{Effect at cast time start}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} Attacking a {{ai|Harrier|Quinn|Vulnerable}} target or consuming a mark grants {{ci|Quinn}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for a short time.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Valor}} gains {{tip|sight}} of the surrounding area for a short time, {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} enemies detected.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Whenever '''Quinn''' uses a basic attack {{tip|on-attack}} against a target marked by ''{{ai|Harrier|Quinn}}'' or consumes their mark, she gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds.
params.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|28 to 80}}%}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|20 to 40}}%}}
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Valor}} grants {{tip|sight}} of the surrounding area for 2 seconds and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} enemy champions within for the same duration.
params.notes: * '''Quinn''' marks enemy champions who were previously unseen but were revealed ''Heightened Senses'' in order to gain [[assist]] credit, lasting for the standard credit timer.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Quinn}} {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}}, {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}}, marking them with {{ai|Harrier|Quinn}}, and briefly {{tip|slow|slowing}} them. She then {{tip|dash|leaps}} backward.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Quinn''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy, marking them with ''{{ai|Harrier|Quinn}}'', dealing {{as|physical damage}}, {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}} a very short distance over {{fd|0.5}} seconds, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 50% decaying over {{fd|1.5}} seconds. She then {{tip|dash|leaps back}} 525 units away from them.
params.description2: ''Vault {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Quinn's''' basic attack timer {{tt|shortly after|See notes}} the initial dash. {{ai|Heightened Senses|Quinn}} can be cast during either of the dashes.''
params.speed: {{dv|{{tt|2500|Initial dash speed, estimated}}|{{tt|850|Return dash speed, estimated}}}}
params.notes:
* '''Quinn''' will track the target if they change locations.
** She will dash to the target's previous location without applying ''Vault's'' effects if the target is too far away or moves beyond {{tt|1200|Estimated}} units.
* ''Vault'' {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Quinn's''' remaining attack cooldown a short delay after the first dash ends (even if interrupted).
** This delay is a fuzzy {{fd|0.25}} to {{fd|0.5}} seconds and this matches up with the moment the target of ''Vault'' is marked with {{ai|Harrier|Quinn}}.
* '''Quinn''' will automatically attempt to attack the target once she completes ''Vault''.
* The target will turn to face the opposite direction after being {{tip|airborne|knocked back}}.
* Unlike its constant cast range ''Vault's'' bounce's can vary to allow '''Quinn''' to close or to make a gap between herself and the target (depending on casting position) or even to jump through a wall (if there is enough landing room on the other side).
* ''Vault's'' {{tip|airborne|knock back}} also interrupts the windup of basic attacks with {{tip|uncancellable windup|uncancellable windups}}.{{bug|2}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Quinn}} {{tip|channels}} for a short time to pair up with {{ci|Valor}}. They then become united, increasing her {{as|{{sti|movement speed}}}} and becoming {{tip|ghosted}}.
params.blurb2: The duo lose the movement speed boost upon taking non-minion damage, and disband upon being {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|silence|silenced}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Quinn''' {{tip|channels}} for 2 seconds, signaling '''{{ci|Valor}}''' to pair up. Upon completion, he picks her up and they unite, increasing her {{sti|ms|{{as|{{tt|'''total''' movement speed|Increases base movement as well as bonus movement speed}}}}}}, granting her {{tip|ghosted|ghosting}}, and allowing her to cast ''{{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}}''. ''Behind Enemy Lines'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds during the channel.
params.description2: Taking damage from non-{{tip|minions}} while ''Behind Enemy Lines'' is active or while '''Quinn''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}} the ability causes her to lose the {{as|'''bonus total''' movement speed}} for 3 seconds. Becoming {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|silence|silenced}} ends ''Behind Enemy Lines'' immediately and puts it on {{sti|cooldown}} without performing ''{{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}}''.
params.description3: Once ''Behind Enemy Lines'' has been learned, [[death|respawning]] or entering {{tt|any|see notes}} [[Spawn|summoning platform]] will spawn '''{{ci|Valor}}''' instantly.
params.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Quinn''' cancels the channel, placing ''Behind Enemy Lines'' on cooldown.
params.notes:
* Taking damage from non-{{tip|minions}} removes the bonus movement speed buff temporarily by suppressing it with the status effect of a {{tip|slow}}.
** This slow is not affected by {{tip|slow resist}} or {{tip|slow immunity}}, but it can be {{tip|cleanse|cleansed}}.
** While the slow is in effect, ''Behind Enemy Lines'' is not considered to grant increased {{as|movement speed}} for the purpose of {{ri|Celerity}}.
* ''Behind Enemy Lines'' does not refund its {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} if the channel was canceled via recast.
** The only exception is if '''Quinn's''' {{as|mana}} falls below the {{as|mana cost}}, in which case she is granted enough {{as|mana}} back (the equal amount needed) to be able to cast ''Behind Enemy Lines'' again.
* [[death|Respawning]] or returning to the [[Spawn|summoning platform]] will not spawn '''{{ci|Valor}}''' if ''Behind Enemy Lines'' is on cooldown.
* If '''{{ci|Valor}}''' is spawned by [[death|respawning]] or returning to the [[Spawn|summoning platform]], {{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}} will be disabled from being manually cast for {{fd|2.5}} seconds upon uniting. However, it will still automatically activate upon declaring a {{tip|basic attack}} or casting {{ai|Blinding Assault|Quinn}} or {{ai|Vault|Quinn}}.
* ''Behind Enemy Lines'' ends immediately without {{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}} being cast if she enters or is inside the enemy [[fountain]]. The ability will go on full {{sti|cooldown}}.
** '''Quinn''' will also spawn '''{{ci|Valor}}''' when entering the enemy fountain.{{bug}}
* Self or allied applied {{tip|immobilize|immobilizations}} such as {{ui|Blast Cone}}, {{ai|Tempered Fate|Bard}}, and {{ii|Zhonya's Hourglass}} also count for ending ''Behind Enemy Lines''.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Quinn''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}:
** ''Behind Enemy Lines'' is not a [[Channel#Movement Channels|movement channel]], and so will not be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} by {{tip|root}} and {{tip|ground}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Quinn}} disbands from {{ci|Valor}} and rains arrows down around her, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies.
params.blurb2: '''Quinn's''' {{tip|basic attack|attacks}} and damaging abilities automatically activate ''Skystrike''.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Quinn''' detaches from '''Valor''', ending ''{{ais|Behind Enemy Lines|Quinn}}'' effects and raining arrows down around her, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies and marking them with ''{{ai|Harrier|Quinn}}''.
params.description2: Declaring a {{tip|basic attack}} or casting ''{{ai|Blinding Assault|Quinn}}'' or ''{{ai|Vault|Quinn}}'' during ''{{ai|Behind Enemy Lines|Quinn}}'' automatically activates ''Skystrike''.
params.notes:
* If '''Quinn''' uses {{ai|Vault|Quinn}} while {{ai|Behind Enemy Lines|Quinn}} is active, ''Skystrike'' will activate at her target's location after she bounces back.
* Upon respawning or recalling, '''Quinn's''' first ''Skytrike'' will deal double the normal amount of damage to enemies hit if activated by an ability.{{bug|1}}
